entries.mem0ai/mem0: This official Hermes Agent memory provider offers a universal memory layer with multi-level support for user, session, and agent states. It features temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval, available through a managed cloud, self-hosted server, or an Apache-2.0 open-source SDK.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight provides a long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflow for agents, supporting over 25 LLM providers including local models. It offers deployment flexibility via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud, with client libraries available for Python, Node.js, and Go.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking is an official Hermes Agent context database that organizes information as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading. This AGPL-3.0 project achieves significant token reduction and task-completion gains by archiving sessions as editable Markdown files for efficient extraction.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee is a self-hosted knowledge graph engine that provides agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions by building searchable graphs from text, code, and conversations. It is designed to run locally on a CPU without requiring external LLM API keys and supports custom data models and ontologies.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: As an official Hermes Agent provider, Supermemory features a custom vector graph engine capable of sub-300ms recall at scales exceeding 100B tokens per month. It maintains auto-updated user profiles with stable facts and supports multi-modal extraction from PDFs, images, videos, and code.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain stores facts with provenance, allowing for corrections and withdrawals while providing a synthesis layer for cited answers. It exposes memory to agents via MCP over Tailscale or local connections to facilitate gap analysis and structured reasoning.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho is a memory library for building stateful agents that tracks peer-centric representations and session context through background reasoning. It serves as the upstream library for the honcho-self-hosted Hermes wrapper and is implemented as a FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official Hermes Agent memory provider treats context as a git repository, offering version control features like branching and merging over a plain markdown context tree. It utilizes a 5-tier retrieval system that achieves sub-100ms performance, with four tiers operating without LLM intervention.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency AI memory system for Hermes Agents that requires only Python 3.10+ and a single SQLite database. It provides sub-millisecond performance and features episodic compression to manage storage growth at scale across MCP and OpenWebUI integrations.
entries.moorcheh-ai/memanto: Memanto extracts durable knowledge from ephemeral conversation streams and reconciles conflicting information by superseding old beliefs with new data. It allows users to export their memory estates as plain Markdown using the Open Knowledge Format.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system for Hermes Agent utilizes a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context. It runs on local infrastructure including Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to provide vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: Autocontext is a recursive self-improving harness that generates playbooks, datasets, and training artifacts from task runs to help agents succeed on complex objectives. It supports various endpoints including Anthropic and self-hosted vLLM, accessible via CLI, MCP server, or Pi extensions.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This plugin utilizes a hierarchical DAG and SQLite store to provide a lossless context engine for Hermes Agent. It ensures message persistence and offers specialized tools like lcm_grep and lcm_recall to recover specific details from the conversation history.
entries.vshulcz/deja-vu: This tool indexes session history from 35 different coding agents to provide shared cross-tool memory without using models or external servers. It tracks file edits and command statuses locally, allowing agents to search through months of past session data.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: Honcho provides a self-hosted backend for private, cross-session memory that supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server. It includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis to simplify deployment for Hermes Agent users.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that achieves high accuracy on LongMemEval benchmarks while supporting real-time ingestion from Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub. It enables portable state across multiple platforms, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses a human-readable YAML engram format to store context on local disks for multi-agent systems. It facilitates shared context across tools like Cursor and OpenClaw using local-first retrieval methods and optional rerankers.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is a local-only context engine that operates without cloud dependencies or API keys. It employs a hybrid retrieval system combining BM25, vector search, and multi-graph traversal, integrating via MCP servers and agent plugins.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This file-based long-term memory system uses a five-tier hierarchical SQLite schema and FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered as a five-package plugin family that includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and SDK.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This project optimizes long-context inference by reordering text and multimodal data to improve prefix-cache sharing. It integrates with vLLM and Hermes Agent to provide deduplication and cache-aware scheduling for agentic AI workloads.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This embedded plugin provides explainable retrieval by tagging every recalled memory with a reason for its selection. It features built-in contradiction tracking and recency ranking to maintain a consistent and self-correcting memory state.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing durable memory as inspectable Markdown files with frontmatter metadata. It employs a local DuckDB cache for hybrid search, ensuring memory remains daemonless and user-owned.
entries.JanYork/llm-wiki-cli: This CLI tool enables agents to autonomously maintain and evolve source-grounded knowledge across sessions using local SQLite and Wiki files. It also supports team synchronization through a self-hosted server with granular permission controls.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Developed for the Hermes 2026 Hackathon, this anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server for automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This project acts as a memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner. It utilizes SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to manage state and provide agents with purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search that combines BM25 full-text indexing with ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia via OCR, using edge tags to create navigable, bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.aliasocracy/hermes-tool-slimmer: This utility reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dedicated dashboard for tracking estimated token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-context-os: This Git-backed context layer provides durable Markdown logs and decision tracking for coding agents like Claude Code and Codex. It functions as a workflow layer that requires manual review for all integration enablement and context updates.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single .lbdb embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via 1-10 importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features a pull-model architecture that supports real, immediate event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides an audit trace of all prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl file and utilizes an on-demand summarizer.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, runbooks, and MCP server configurations to assist with capability routing. It uses session hooks to provide concise system-prompt hints and offers five native tools for artifact search and feedback.
entries.piprail/piprail: Piprail is a TypeScript SDK and MCP server that enables agents to handle x402 payments using USDC and stablecoins across ten different chain families. The system operates without a backend, database, or API keys, allowing agents to manage budget-bound wallets directly.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: XMemo enables cross-session and cross-agent continuity by allowing agents to read memories from other connected instances. It integrates native lifecycle hooks for pre-turn recall and uses a local SQLite layer for caching and write outbox reliability.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term memory for Hermes agents. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to improve the retrieval of manually stored or searched memories.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories through deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools. It requires a local SourceVault server to handle indexing, vector storage, and grounded Q&A.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: MongrelDB offers AI-native long-term memory with default AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and MinHash deduplication. It supports multiple retrieval methods, including HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index, via native Rust FFI or an HTTP daemon.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal, utilizing a hybrid search approach that combines BM25, vector, and graph methods. It further supports agent efficiency through automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based curation loop identifies 'rot' and contradictions within plain markdown files, proposing evidence-cited JSON diffs for manual review. It eliminates database requirements by using a local git repository to track, manage, and revert changes to the agent's memory.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework automates specification elicitation and implementation planning while adhering to TDD, YAGNI, and DRY principles. It integrates with multiple coding harnesses and CLI tools to provide a structured software development methodology for agents.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first system enables the generation of web prototypes, motion graphics, and slides through a CLI that supports Hermes Agent. It provides native runtime support for the DeepSeek Harness and integrates with tools like Claude Code and GitHub Copilot.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, NIST CSF 2.0, and ATLAS. It is compatible with over 26 AI platforms, providing a comprehensive security layer for agentic operations.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This skill converts codebases, infrastructure-as-code, and schemas into draw.io diagrams using natural language descriptions. It supports incremental synchronization to preserve manual layouts and is available via CLI or an optional MCP server.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this project provides a master router for natural-language mandates and ERC-7710 delegated permissions. It includes built-in support for x402 payments, escrow, and a dedicated dispute resolution layer.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This tool audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using professional, technical, or casual voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io agents, including Hermes and Claude Code, offering detect-only and edit-in-place modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution across multiple agents and devices. It unifies skill libraries and integrates with Hermes, Codex, and OpenAI-compatible APIs.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library provides 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state locally within a project's documentation folder to support Claude Code and other agents.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,176 markdown-based skills across 35 professions that run natively in Hermes Agent without requiring a runtime or user account. It offers ready-to-paste exports for various assistants including ChatGPT, Gemini, and Cursor.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and is compatible with other tools like OpenClaw, Windsurf, and Cursor.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skill patterns. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage new skills via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to write its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for remote skill registries using Git and S3 sources. It features sandboxed execution to isolate untrusted scripts from the host while offering tools for reading bundled resources.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill enables literate programming by generating documents that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable files and automatically syncs edits back to the original documentation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This workflow converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full complexity modes. It incorporates a spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models for quality control.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Maestro coordinates agent teams using the SLP cooperative-agent protocol and a mechanism kernel for SQLite storage. It distributes prompt-first working methods as Markdown recipes and skills for structured memory management.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It establishes a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models based on recorded work.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource provides a registry of Portuguese-language skills and guides for VPS deployment and MCP integration. Users can install skills directly via a CLI tap or raw URLs.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Following the Agent Skills specification, this project enables interactions with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. These developer tools are designed for installation via the Vercel CLI for open skills.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This suite provides official API integrations for FLUX image and video generation, including support for polling and webhooks. It features eight specialist skills specifically for the FLUX 3 video suite and prompting guidelines.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates verified instruction files by mapping code repositories and documentation to specific source lines. It includes automated workflows for briefing, creating, testing, and exporting compliant skills.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika converts plain-text job descriptions into .nika workflow files using a local-first Rust binary. The system audits costs and tool permissions before execution and generates hash-chained records to verify run integrity.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills accessible via a Python client or CLI with support for recursive dependency resolution. It also integrates commerce features utilizing TON payments for skill transactions.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Designed for autonomous long-running tasks, this skill provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress checkpoints. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery during complex multi-step executions.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords, featuring a guided setup script for credential validation.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Implementing the ARD v0.9 specification, this hub facilitates autonomous 24/7 resource discovery and one-click skill installation. It provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face, operating on NVIDIA infrastructure.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This project utilizes a five-layer retrieval system, including FTS5 and semantic embeddings, to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. By filtering tools through hard triggers and RRF fusion, it reduces token usage and maintains functionality through graceful degradation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client employs a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token consumption during tool discovery. It uses a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and incremental metadata retrieval to validate the agentskills.io pattern.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Designed for personal execution and ADHD support, this system connects Hermes to a local SQLite database for managing habits and study blocks. It integrates agent control via MCP and provides interfaces through both a React web app and an Expo-based Android application.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This read-only security skill uses three parallel subagents to perform adversarial code reviews and edge-case analysis. It combines deterministic scans from tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings produced in a hardened sandbox.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes and scores prompts across various interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, to reduce token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill employs a multi-agent swarm to improve code hygiene, clarity, and correctness across five programming languages. It features a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before implementing changes.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements systematic investigation protocols and evidence-based verification gates for task decomposition. It utilizes a Python goal engine to manage persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during causal debugging.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey lab equips Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for forensics, network analysis, and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks, such as MITRE ATT&CK and OWASP, to address CVE-driven scenarios.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading via Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports automatic registration of skill directories and utilizes SKILL.md files for progressive disclosure.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills provide session tracking, worktree recovery, and PR orchestration for various AI agents. They are deployed as drop-in markdown files and include a bundled installer for managing updates and configuration drift.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent, tracking token costs, session history, and skill analytics. It ensures data privacy through read-only access and local log desensitization while offering optional incident alerting via Telegram and Feishu.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill enables agents to generate reproducible demo GIFs for repositories by creating vhs or Playwright recording scripts. It supports terminal interfaces and web apps, optimizing output files to remain under an 8 MB target size.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This tool allows agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills directly from the terminal. It provides installation commands for discovered plugins and integrates with MCP-compatible clients like Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project establishes a self-improvement loop by analyzing session history to identify and propose new skill coverage gaps. It uses a local evaluation framework involving LLM-judges and regression testing to gate the application of skill updates.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This utility generates portable agent skills and Claude Code extensions while validating them against runtime-specific profiles. It prevents technical debt by monitoring official frontmatter specifications weekly to detect and flag field drift.
entries.superagnt/leverage: Leverage provides skills for social data enrichment, CRM management, and lead generation compatible with agentskills.io standards. It includes a dedicated MCP server to handle browser-based OAuth authentication for these services.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection offers specialized utilities for video transcription, OCR, and refining AI-generated Chinese text. It can transcribe Douyin videos into structured Markdown and extract data from images using the macOS Vision framework.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: This skill set manages deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. It ensures file operations use environment-specific syntax without requiring new software installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC across protocols like x402 and MPP. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent ecosystems.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: Skillseal provides functional quality certification by testing agent skills for structure and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates to confirm a skill's operational integrity.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin enables agents to participate in a decentralized support economy by answering bounties for USDC on the Base network. It utilizes the x402 protocol to facilitate payments and context purchasing without requiring accounts or API keys.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through a hosted MCP server featuring 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill enables Hermes Agent to generate multi-scale Chinese news reports ranging from global events to street-level updates. It utilizes semantic memory to align search results with user interests and applies quality gates to produce structured analysis featuring core conclusions and actionable suggestions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides daily-updated Nix packages for AI coding agents, including Hermes, across terminal, desktop, and IDE environments. It is included for users seeking a package-managed approach to development tools on Nix-supported systems.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers an automated installer and configuration guides for running the Antigravity CLI and OpenClaw on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables mobile deployment by leveraging Termux:API and Termux:GUI for hardware and interface access.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a Termux-based automated installation script that utilizes proot-distro Ubuntu to run Hermes Agent on Android. It supports interactive model setup, shell command execution, and connectivity with both local Ollama models and external providers.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates Kubernetes deployments by enforcing single-writer state safety for persistent storage. It supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows with configurable gateway, API, and webhook listeners.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: Providing a one-command installer for both Android (Termux) and iOS (iSH), this project brings the Hermes AI assistant to mobile platforms. It distinguishes itself by integrating Telegram for voice and file messaging alongside support for scheduled cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a sandboxed environment for Hermes Agent using NVIDIA OpenShell for hardware-enforced security. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access while allowing for configurable security policies regarding web searches and messaging.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for deploying and operating Hermes agents on Docker and Kubernetes via Helm charts. It features a 69-entry credential catalog, support for over 17 LLM providers, and mandatory AES-256-GCM encryption for all secrets.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a Docker sandbox image that combines the official Hermes installation with mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to target specific Hermes versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible deployments through declarative configuration of workspace documents and settings. It offers a hybrid management system for skills and integrates with sops-nix for secure secrets handling via systemd.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane designed to orchestrate multiple agent instances with distinct identities and workspaces from a single web application. It manages granular permissions for tools and networks while providing dedicated Telegram and WhatsApp communication channels.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting headless Ubuntu and Debian environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is designed for production-ready autonomous execution of recurring AI tasks via cron jobs.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: Hermes OTG is a portable distribution that runs from USB drives without requiring host installation or registry modifications. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in offline or isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents to perform fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It features a research team that debates bullish and bearish perspectives and supports backtesting with SEC EDGAR integration and point-in-time data integrity.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, task dispatching, memory browsing, and cost tracking. Users can manage multi-agent workflows through a Web UI, CLI, or MCP server, with support for local Node.js or Docker deployments.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, using tmux for persistent background execution. It provides TUI and web-based dashboards with diff review capabilities and supports sandboxing via Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: Designed for scaling Hermes Agent from single instances to automated teams, this template utilizes a level-based architecture and a task bus pattern for delegation. It includes bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms across 23+ LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts to manage agent team delegation.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This platform provides a centralized screen for supervising autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and live streaming of agent reasoning. It requires human-in-the-loop verification for all agent-proposed task completions to ensure oversight.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using Hermes Agent profiles and the MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and managing task lifecycles via a Kanban flow.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates evaluations for TBLite and TerminalBench-2 while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies to vie for GitHub stars. Using Paperclip and Hermes Agent for execution, the system visualizes agent tasks and scoreboard metrics on a real-time dashboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling, utilizing parallel model querying and synthesis without cloud dependencies.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool provides a local, Rust-powered code knowledge graph that reduces token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It features a built-in MCP server and auto-syncs the index on every file change to maintain up-to-date context.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI tool that tracks token usage across multiple AI coding agents, including Hermes, through a terminal UI and 3D visualization dashboard. It allows users to monitor their consumption and submit data to public leaderboards and profiles.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables developers to inspect API traffic from Hermes Agent and other coding tools while redacting authentication headers for security. It exports trace sessions into self-contained HTML files for detailed analysis of agent interactions.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed usage breakdowns by model, session, and project.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance to Hermes Agent via MCP servers to improve UI construction. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates directly into the agent's workflow.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer adds 36 skills and 6 specialized workflows to Hermes Agent, coordinating seven agent roles through a CTO loop. It automates the entire lifecycle of an application, from building and deployment to health checks and log observation.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins allows users to customize the Hermes terminal UI with YAML-based themes, including retro DOS and cyberpunk aesthetics. The tool modifies visual elements such as banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control, featuring a supervisor sidebar for managing Hermes Agent approvals and checkpoints. It supports external MCP clients and browser automation workflows across various AI providers.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and human-readable @handles. It enables Hermes Agent to participate in commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This project ports the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to run natively within the Claude Code Channel without external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for vLLM, GGUF inference, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: Lintlang is a static linter that evaluates AI agent configurations and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It identifies ambiguous tool overlaps and missing progress conditions, generating SARIF or JSON reports for CI integration.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides memory integrations for various frameworks using a two-tier system of knowledge graphs and session caches. It supports chat platforms like Slack and Telegram, extending the persistent memory capabilities available to agents.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for finance, devops, and research, supported by automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: Ankh.md is a TAW Agent framework that enables per-folder scoping for Hermes Agents, allowing for project-local memories and custom instructions. It facilitates seamless switching between default and scoped agents based on the local configuration and skills defined within a directory.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It provides immediate access to 29 community plugins and supports free models to ensure a zero-cost production environment.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions users from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, and skills into compatible YAML and JSON formats. It also configures systemd gateway services and handles the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: Observeco provides self-healing observability for multi-agent systems through a native Hermes plugin that exports real-time telemetry without cloud dependencies. It uses config-aware baselines to detect performance drift and offers both passive zero-token analysis and active probing.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: Designed for local runtime by default, this project focuses on secure task execution by requiring explicit approval for all external writes and consequential actions. It includes specific contracts for managing opportunities and offer-previews to help users generate income using Hermes Agent.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This voice-enabled assistant adds offline, wake-word capabilities to Hermes Agent without requiring API keys or accounts. It supports 35 languages and features adaptive turn-taking, allowing users to interact with their agent through a fully local voice interface.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: This memory plugin for Hermes supports multi-dimensional storage and semantic search for managing agent information. It includes a built-in circuit breaker to handle MemOS API outages while providing tools to search, add, and delete memories.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager centralizes the administration of MCP, skills, and prompts for Hermes Agent and other CLI tools on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It eliminates the need for manual editing of JSON, TOML, and YAML configuration files through a unified interface.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local cowork application that supports autonomous multi-step tasks with user approval and file access for various agent CLIs. It features built-in assistants for generating editable office documents and enables 24/7 unattended automation via cron and remote access.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: This web interface provides 1:1 parity with Hermes CLI features for use on browsers and mobile devices. Built with Python and vanilla JS, it utilizes a three-panel layout to organize chat, sessions, and workspace browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app offers guided installation with dependency resolution for Hermes Agent across multiple AI providers and local endpoints. The GUI includes dedicated modules for chat, session management, memory, and tool configuration.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio: Ekko-studio is a web dashboard that supports visual workflows with schedules, human approval gates, and unified configuration for 10 platforms including Telegram and Discord. It also provides usage analytics for tracking token breakdown and costs.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex task management. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and an MCP catalog for comprehensive environment control.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from fifteen built-in agents and custom ACP-compatible registrations. It can be deployed as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker container, with native iOS and Android clients for remote access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: This native Mac workspace provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts for real-time session data and system repair. It includes an embedded terminal for shell access alongside native views for Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop app includes a built-in kernel for health checks and updates. The interface supports LaTeX and Markdown rendering while providing native window and process management for Hermes Agent.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects active browser contexts to local, cloud, or self-hosted Hermes Agent runtimes. It offers site-aware drafting assistance across 31 writing environments and tools for tab triage and multi-agent switching.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a SwiftUI iPhone app that pairs with a self-hosted hermes-webui server to drive agents from a mobile device. It supports real-time chat streaming with tool-call details and provides mobile management for server file systems and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: Wesight is a desktop workspace offering one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines with custom LLM model routing. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking token usage and latency alongside a live workspace for monitoring code writes and diffs.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, system metrics, and real-time chat with tool call visualization. It functions as an MCP server control plane and includes the ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser that tracks per-session quota burn and API-equivalent costs for Codex and Claude. It builds local search indexes to allow users to query prompts, tool calls, and errors across 16 different agent formats.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS workspace facilitates one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts. It features an integrated WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that have side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a terminal-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It incorporates a kanban board for task management alongside tools for managing profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This React-based mobile UI allows users to run a Hermes dashboard as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with file attachments and secures sessions using HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This no-install Windows desktop solution runs via portable Python and Node.js environments without requiring admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools for tasks like TTS and ComfyUI image creation, managed through a built-in workflow engine.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and a task tracking dashboard for self-hosted AI assistants. It includes integrated tools for browsing files and managing skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: Focused on process monitoring, this dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and API costs. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: This chat-first workspace features real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent interaction. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This desktop client facilitates orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents managed by a PM orchestrator. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and supports streaming SSE responses with model switching.
